description: PI-PAR-009 (arrrrny/pi#47): evidence-backed TUI adaptation decisions. One entry per packages/tui behavior row in coverage/registry/behavior-registry.json. decision is port|adapt|not_applicable; owner is the approving maintainer; destination is the Dart package that adapts the behavior (port/adapt) or null (not_applicable, with an evidence reason). No full-parity claim is allowed while any TUI row lacks a decision here (enforced by scripts/coverage/check-release-evidence.mjs).
